text_markup: A card that moves from its location to a hidden or secret location becomes a new object, even if the new location is in the same zone.
text_plain: A card that moves from its location to a hidden or secret location becomes a new object, even if the new location is in the same zone.

examples.text_markup: The Corp scores {card:Accelerated Beta Test}, looks at the top 3 cards of R&D, and installs and rezzes a piece of ice from among them. As a chain reaction, the Corp then uses {card:The Foundry: Refining the Process} to search R&D, with the result that the other cards currently being looked at by {card:Accelerated Beta Test} are shuffled along with the rest of R&D. Since the cards were moved to an unknown location in R&D, {card:Accelerated Beta Test} can no longer act on them, so those cards can no longer be looked at and will not be installed or trashed.
examples.text_plain: The Corp scores Accelerated Beta Test, looks at the top 3 cards of R&D, and installs and rezzes a piece of ice from among them. As a chain reaction, the Corp then uses The Foundry: Refining the Process to search R&D, with the result that the other cards currently being looked at by Accelerated Beta Test are shuffled along with the rest of R&D. Since the cards were moved to an unknown location in R&D, Accelerated Beta Test can no longer act on them, so those cards can no longer be looked at and will not be installed or trashed.

examples.text_markup: The top card of R&D in the current game state is an object. So is the 2nd card from the top of R&D, the 3rd card, and so on. If the Corp plays {card:Precognition} and rearranges the top 5 cards of R&D, the Runner will not know which cards correspond to which objects in the previous order, so the cards become new objects under their new order.
